title: Idealism is the more parsimonious inference

statements.text: Every ontology except solipsism infers something beyond direct experience. Physicalism infers a new ontological class outside consciousness, while idealism only extends consciousness beyond its personal boundaries, which is the more parsimonious inference.

sources.quote: Clearly, the former is a more parsimonious inference and, as such, not equivalent to the latter.
The principle of parsimony implies that, of the two interpretations of cosmopsychism discussed above, idealist cosmopsychism is more economical
